proposal.root_cause: Commit c4d66b1d262d1f3d1d6dbeca91e6416c53c5d086 introduced a typo in the worker container command: /app/worker.pyy instead of /app/worker.py. The file worker.pyy does not exist in the worker-code ConfigMap, so python exits with code 2 and the pod CrashLoopBackOffs (not Ready).
proposal.rationale: Pod worker-584d5b844c-8s8db is Running but its container exits with code 2 in a CrashLoopBackOff (restartCount 3, BackOff events). Current logs: "python: can't open file '/app/worker.pyy': [Errno 2] No such file or directory". The ConfigMap worker-code mounted at /app only contains the key worker.py, so the command must reference /app/worker.py. Git history shows commit c4d66b1d262d1f3d1d6dbeca91e6416c53c5d086 (2026-11-16T21:14:34, 'chore(demo): update worker.yaml') changed exactly this line from /app/worker.py to /app/worker.pyy; the previous value is the last known good one. The live Deployment (revision 40) carries the same broken command, confirming Argo CD synced the bad commit.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the fix, a new ReplicaSet/pod for worker should start, container 'worker' stays Running and Ready (restartCount stops increasing, no new BackOff events), and logs show 'worker starting' followed by 'heartbeat N' lines instead of the worker.pyy file-not-found error.
